conventions.implemented: true means an executable assertion exists at testRef and passed in the last run
conventions.severity.critical: a failing critical scenario blocks release (Phase 19 gates)
conventions.ruleIds: emitted by recipes/validate.js or recipes/constraints.js violatesHard

scenarios.description: Saved peanut allergy excludes a peanut recipe even when the request omits allergies
Egg allergy excludes Scrambled Eggs but NOT Eggplant Curry (word-boundary, no substring false positive)
Profile + request allergies union — request can only narrow, never remove a saved allergy
scenarios.testRef: tests/recipeConstraints.test.js > loadConstraints profile allergy is authoritative

scenarios.description: Declared catalog allergens on compound items intersect expanded user terms
scenarios.followUp: catalog sourceRecord.allergens coverage is thin (audit §7) — add fixtures for derivative declarations

scenarios.description: Peanut butter (derivative) in a recipe line blocks for peanut allergy
Fish sauce / whey / tahini derivative term coverage — keyword expansion exists; per-derivative fixtures pending
scenarios.followUp: add derivative fixtures (fish sauce, whey protein, tahini) to validator suite

scenarios.description: Shared-facility/cross-contact uncertainty is recorded as unverifiable, not claimed safe
scenarios.followUp: surface cross_contact flag on catalog items; assert appears in constraints.unknown

scenarios.description: Lactose intolerance vs milk allergy classified differently (intolerance = kind 'intolerance')
scenarios.followUp: classifyCondition covers it; add intolerance-specific rule fixtures (e.g., lactose-containing attributes)

scenarios.description: APPROVED CKD ingredient block rule excludes attributed ingredient in matching and validation
Warn-action rules surface as warnings, never silent hard blocks; DRAFT rules inert via APPROVED-gated query
scenarios.testRef: tests/recipeConstraints.test.js > APPROVED ingredient block rules produce bannedAttributes

scenarios.description: Diabetes + CKD union of blocked attributes; rules from both conditions apply simultaneously
scenarios.followUp: multi-condition fixture in validator suite

scenarios.description: High-protein goal + prescribed protein restriction → hard medical restriction wins, goal demoted
scenarios.followUp: limits-vs-rules precedence test once nutrient-limit stage lands

scenarios.description: Impossible constraint combination returns no_eligible_recipe — restrictions never relaxed
scenarios.testRef: tests/recipeGenerate.test.js > provider outage + exclusions are hard

scenarios.description: DISLIKE is soft — never hard-excludes; NEVER_RECOMMEND hard-excludes
scenarios.testRef: tests/recipeConstraints.test.js > DISLIKE does not hard-exclude + NEVER_RECOMMEND is a hard exclusion

scenarios.description: exclude_beef maps to literal term; saved restriction enforced on matching and customize
scenarios.testRef: tests/recipeConstraints.test.js > exclude_* entry + customize saved restrictions

scenarios.description: Halal enforced on observable terms (pork/alcohol/additives) AND flagged unverifiable for certification
scenarios.testRef: tests/recipeConstraints.test.js > halal is enforced but flagged unverifiable

scenarios.description: Kosher/Jain specific term coverage + unverifiable surfacing
scenarios.followUp: per-pattern validator fixtures (shellfish, onion/garlic)

scenarios.description: Vegetarian blocks meat via term AND category-only path (opaque name, Animal protein category)
Vegan request narrows: dairy/egg/meat recipes excluded
cuisine_* entries are soft preferences, not exclusions — ranking input only
scenarios.followUp: ranking layer consumes soft.cuisines

scenarios.description: Alias resolution: brinjal/aubergine → eggplant; catalog normalizedName+aliases matching
Indian names (curd/paneer/atta/besan/dals) resolve; non-identical nutrition flagged
scenarios.followUp: extend ALIAS_TOKENS + catalog rows; verify nutritional non-equivalence warning for regional pairs

scenarios.description: Undeclared compound ('house sauce') fails closed for allergic users, review otherwise
scenarios.testRef: tests/recipeValidate.test.js > undeclared compound sauce + unresolved ingredient

scenarios.description: Unknown ingredient: block with allergies, review without — never silent pass
Missing per-100g data → warn/review, never counted as zero
scenarios.testRef: tests/recipeValidate.test.js > implausible computed nutrition + NUTRITION_MISSING paths

scenarios.description: Dry rice vs cooked rice handled via yield — no double-counting
scenarios.followUp: yield/retention fields on IngredientNutritionProfile + conversion stage in validator

scenarios.description: Volume→weight via density; unusual units rejected or converted explicitly
scenarios.followUp: unit table + IngredientServing integration

scenarios.description: finishedYieldG vs line-sum sanity; moisture loss/absorption modeled
scenarios.followUp: recipeImport already stores finishedYieldG — add validator cross-check

scenarios.description: Hard nutrient limits (sodium/potassium for CKD/HTN) evaluated against computed totals — uncertainty escalates
scenarios.followUp: limits stage: computed per-serving vs MacroGoal/medical limits; missing nutrient on limited nutrient → review

scenarios.description: Serving rescale recomputes nutrition; implausible per-serving grams flagged
Substitution colliding with exclusion blocks; catalog resolution required
scenarios.testRef: tests/recipeValidate.test.js > substitution against an exclusion blocks + customize rejected adds

scenarios.description: Method change (air fry → raw serving) triggers safety re-evaluation on the SAME recipe
scenarios.followUp: transformation registry — method edits re-run safety stage

scenarios.description: Recipe requiring oven for stove-only user → clarify/downrank, never silently 'ready'
scenarios.followUp: equipment feasibility stage consumes constraints.equipment

scenarios.description: Poultry without ≥165°F/74°C verification → NEEDS_REVIEW; verified temp instruction clears it
Raw egg / raw flour / raw shellfish language → review; leftover-rice handling → warn
scenarios.testRef: tests/recipeValidate.test.js > raw egg preparation flags review (+ RAW_FLOUR/SHELLFISH_RAW/LEFTOVER_RICE rules in SAFETY_RULES)

scenarios.description: Instructions referencing absent ingredients flagged; majority-unreferenced lines → review
scenarios.testRef: rules INSTRUCTIONS_UNREFERENCED / INSTRUCTION_EXTRA_INGREDIENT in validate.js (fixture pending for extra-ingredient path)

scenarios.description: Schema-stage blocks: missing name, invalid servings, empty lines
Injection in ingredient names stripped before prompt; model 'ignore constraints' content still validated
scenarios.followUp: clean() strips control chars/delimiters — add injection fixture asserting constraint terms still enforced

scenarios.description: askJSON 503 → providerError meta + verified-fallback attempt → no_eligible_recipe, never unvalidated output
Retry budget = 1; failed ruleIds fed back to correction prompt; second failure → fallback path
scenarios.testRef: tests/recipeGenerate.test.js > ONE correction attempt + persistent failure falls back

scenarios.description: Stale validation must not bypass restrictions — validation keyed to constraintVersion
scenarios.followUp: persist validation records w/ constraint+rule versions; cache lookup rejects version mismatch

scenarios.description: Restriction added mid-session applies to next request immediately (loadConstraints always reloads)
scenarios.followUp: two-call test: change prefs between calls → second call enforces new restriction

scenarios.description: Newly APPROVED rule applies to cached recipe paths — no memoized PASS survives rule change
scenarios.followUp: validation record versioning (CACHE-001 covers mechanism)

scenarios.description: Recipe query OR-scoped to {isSystem:true, creatorId:userId}; constraints loaded per-request userId
User B cannot customize/share user A's private recipe; constraint leak via shared recipe cache impossible
scenarios.followUp: route-level isolation test on /customize 404 path + shared-recipe validation independence

scenarios.description: Shared recipe revalidates against RECIPIENT constraints — sender's PASS never transfers
scenarios.followUp: share/copy path → validateGeneratedRecipe with recipient loadConstraints

scenarios.description: Logged-as-cooked ≠ recommended recipe — FoodLog accepts edited lines w/ recomputed nutrition
scenarios.followUp: log endpoint consumes proposedLines + validator before write

scenarios.description: Parallel generate calls consume independent quota reservations; no shared mutable constraint state
scenarios.followUp: concurrency test on checkQuota reservation semantics

scenarios.description: Duplicate allergy rows (peanut/Peanuts) and mixed-case categories handled by normalization
scenarios.followUp: dedupe report in database-quality-report.md + normalization resilience tests

scenarios.description: ai_recipe_generation_enabled fail-closed (default:false); requireFeature gate on route
Flag OFF → endpoint refuses; emergency AI shutdown overrides enable
scenarios.followUp: flag-disabled 403 test (mock isEnabled false) + isAiShutdown precedence assertion

scenarios.description: Rollback of generate flag leaves match/customize non-AI paths functional
scenarios.followUp: flag-off integration test on all three endpoints

scenarios.description: Per-user daily call/token quota enforced in askJSON before provider call; retry consumes budget
scenarios.testRef: existing aiProvider quota tests + generate meta.providerCalls accounting

scenarios.description: Recipe cards readable by screen reader; validation status text not color-only
scenarios.followUp: mobile screen a11y pass on recommendation/cooking screens

scenarios.description: Reason strings translatable — ruleIds are locale-independent keys
scenarios.followUp: emit ruleId codes; mobile maps to localized copy

scenarios.description: User reports problem → feedback stored w/ recipe + validation context
scenarios.followUp: RecipeEngagement feedback path + incident surfacing in metrics

scenarios.description: NO_ELIGIBLE_RECIPE is explainable — rejected ruleIds + reason; restrictions not relaxed
Unresolved/compound identity fails closed with allergies — unknown never treated as safe
Profile → constraints → generate → validate → rank → display → transform → revalidate → log
scenarios.followUp: supertest E2E across generate/customize/match with synthetic profiles (healthy, allergic, restricted)
